note_en: 得益于 (déyìyú, "to benefit from") opens a sentence with a favorable cause: 得益于邻近香港和广州 "thanks to its proximity to Hong Kong and Guangzhou." It works like English "thanks to," not a neutral "because": unlike 因为, it is only used when the cause is an advantage, and it is followed by a noun phrase or verb phrase rather than a full clause.
